Advertiser: Zenith Arc
Started: 28 Apr 2026
🚪5 Genius Interior Design Hacks You’ll Wish You Knew Sooner!
Welcome to our latest transformation at 134 Jalan Bukit Merah
— where every inch of space works harder than it looks! 😍
Here’s how we turned a compact flat into a smart, functional
dream home 👇 ✨ 1️⃣ Extendable Dining Table – Dinner for two
or ten? No problem. It expands only when you need it. 🚪 2️⃣
Synchronised Sliding Door – One smooth glide — easy without
bulky frames. 🧺 3️⃣ Hidden Inner Drawer – Secret compartments
that keep your clutter out of sight, but within reach. 🍽️ 4️⃣
Pull-Down Dish Rack – Upper cabinet storage made practical
(and kinda satisfying to use 😏). 🗄️ 5️⃣ Space Tower Pantry –
The ultimate space-saving hack — tall, organized, and
everything visible at a glance. 💡 Pro tip: When designed
right, even a small HDB can feel spacious, modern, and totally
YOU. 📍 134 Jalan Bukit Merah Designed by @zenitharc.sg —
where smart design meets everyday living 💫 #ZenithArc
